build_method: python build.py --jobs 1: all local sources compiled with lake env lean and dependency-sensitive source fingerprints
public_dependencies: Pinned public Lake dependencies (lake-manifest.json): .lake/packages is a directory junction to the .lake/packages of a development project, which holds the same revisions, with Mathlib objects from the public Mathlib build cache. No compiled local module was reused.
local_environment_notes: The build was pinned to one CPU core (Windows processor affinity) with build.py --jobs 1, while other work ran on the same machine.

The full build of an earlier source commit took 95840 s, including a Lake phase of 3835 s. Two later source commits changed the linter attributes or argument lists of four declarations; build.py --resume then recompiled the changed modules and every module depending on them from the final sources. build_seconds is the time of the last of these runs.
